AR01.en: SAPPER: La, La, Lili Marleen. OK, what are we doing now?
AR01.zh: 工兵：啦，啦，莉莉·玛莲。好了，我们现在干什么？

FT01.en: SNIPER: Looks like Frenchy and Paul have been captured. However, Butcher has managed to hide in one of the trucks. You know what that means?
FT01.zh: 狙击手：看来法国佬和保罗被抓了。不过，屠夫已经躲进了一辆卡车里。你知道这意味着什么吗？

AR02.en: SAPPER: Sure, don't blow up the trucks.
AR02.zh: 工兵：当然，别炸掉那些卡车。

FT02.en: SNIPER: Exactly, I know how you love your explosives but let’s exercise a little caution on this one.
FT02.zh: 狙击手：没错，我知道你有多爱炸药，但这次咱们得小心点。

CH01.en: ALLIED SOLDIER: Reporting for duty sir!
CH01.zh: 盟军士兵：长官，前来报到！

FLMA.en: SOME OF THE ART HAS BEEN DESTROYED

OR01.en: Stop the convoy and recover the works of art.

TIP1.en: Anti-personnel Mine: Only placed by the Sapper. Left-Click on the desired location to activate. You can also deactivate mines and pick them up. You cannot step on mines that you have set.
TIP1.zh: 反步兵地雷：只能由工兵布设。左键点击选定位置即可布雷。你也可以解除地雷并将其拾起。自己布设的地雷不会踩响。
